summary.text: Lucia Baez-Geller is the Democratic candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 106 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Fabián Basabe.
A former teacher, she served on the Miami-Dade County Public Schools school board from 2020 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Lucia Baez-Geller earned a bachelor's degree from Spring Hill College in 2005 and a graduate degree from Florida International University.
She taught at Miami Beach Senior High from 2005 to 2020, and in 2013 received the Political Advocate of the Year Award from the National Education Association.

Ballotpedia lists her affiliations with the Educational Excellence School Advisory Council, the Association of Latino Administrators and Superintendents, the Hispanic Scholarship Fund as a media ambassador, and the League of Women Voters as education chair.

Baez-Geller was elected to the Miami-Dade County Public Schools school board, District 3, in 2020, assumed office on November 17, 2020, and left office on November 19, 2024; she did not run for re-election.
In 2024 she won the Democratic primary for U.S. House Florida District 27 with 54.2% of the vote and lost the general election to incumbent Republican Maria Elvira Salazar.
In 2026 she won the Democratic primary for state House District 106 with 57.3% of the vote (4,718 votes), defeating Ashley Litwin Diego.
